analysis.company_profile: Catawiki runs a global online auction platform that connects millions of users with tens of thousands of items daily, offering a marketplace for collectibles, art and other high‑value goods.

candidate_positioning: Senior AI Engineer with proven production ML, MLOps, and data‑product experience, ready to deliver scalable, high‑impact ML solutions for Catawiki’s auction platform.

team_needs.need: Build production‑ready, robust and scalable ML models
team_needs.evidence: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Viavi: built SLA breach prediction system with Random Forest, LightGBM, FastAPI, MLflow; Senior AI Engineer at Optum: built LangGraph analytics system and lab extraction agent
team_needs.gap: No explicit large‑scale production deployment on Kubernetes for real‑time serving

team_needs.need: Explore mobile/web data and apply advanced statistics to business problems
team_needs.evidence: Data Scientist at Viavi: anomaly detection and demand forecasting on telecom KPI time‑series; Data Analyst at United Health Group: ad‑hoc analysis using Hive, SQL, Power BI
team_needs.gap: Experience is telecom/health data, not mobile/web user behavior

team_needs.need: Deploy models on Kubernetes/GCP with CI/CD pipelines
team_needs.evidence: Skill set includes Kubernetes, Docker, GCP, Jenkins, Bitbucket; built FastAPI services packaged with MLflow
team_needs.gap: No documented end‑to‑end Kubernetes deployment of a model‑serving service

team_needs.need: Communicate model insights to non‑technical stakeholders
team_needs.evidence: Delivered POCs, dashboards, and stakeholder workshops across multiple roles
team_needs.gap: No specific example of non‑technical communication of model outcomes

team_needs.evidence: RAG‑based Project Discovery Assistant (semantic retrieval) and LangGraph analytics system
team_needs.gap: No direct recommender or auction marketplace experience

project.name: Real‑time Auction Item Recommendation Engine
project.problem: Catawiki needs to surface personalized item recommendations to millions of bidders in real time, improving engagement and conversion while handling billions of events daily.
project.approach: Leverage the candidate’s expertise in cross‑encoder re‑ranking and LangGraph orchestration to build a hybrid recommendation pipeline: (1) generate candidate items using collaborative‑filtering embeddings stored in pgvector; (2) re‑rank with a fine‑tuned cross‑encoder trained on historical click‑through and bid data; (3) enrich results with LLM‑driven contextual explanations via Claude; (4) serve predictions through a FastAPI microservice packaged in Docker, deployed on GKE with MLflow tracking and CI/CD via Jenkins/Bitbucket; (5) monitor latency and quality with Elasticsearch/Kibana dashboards.

requirements_not_covered: direct recommender‑system experience in an online marketplace
demonstrated large‑scale real‑time serving of billions of events
